brief: The customer onboarding flow that cut our churn in half — every node mapped.

slots.title: Onboarding Blueprint
slots.subtitle: The customer flow that reduced churn by fifty percent.
slots.check1: Maps every critical touchpoint in the user journey
slots.check2: Replaces guesswork with a repeatable activation system
slots.check3: Cuts churn by guiding users to value faster

slots.title: Welcome Sequence
slots.subtitle: The first impression that sets the tone for retention.
slots.check1: Confirms value within sixty seconds of signup
slots.check2: Delivers one clear next step via email
slots.check3: Reduces anxiety with transparent timeline promises
slots.takeawayBody: Users who open welcome emails are three times more likely to activate.

slots.title: Setup Wizard
slots.subtitle: Guided configuration that prevents early abandonment and confusion.
slots.check1: Breaks complex tasks into three micro-steps
slots.check2: Shows progress bar to maintain user momentum
slots.check3: Saves progress automatically to reduce drop-off
slots.takeawayBody: Each extra setup field increases abandonment by ten percent.

slots.title: First Value
slots.subtitle: Engineering an early aha moment drives long-term stickiness.
slots.check1: Surfaces pre-built template based on user role
slots.check2: Celebrates completion with instant positive feedback
slots.check3: Requires under two minutes to first output
slots.takeawayBody: Never let users leave empty-handed after their first session.

slots.title: Team Invite
slots.subtitle: Turning individual users into sticky collaborative accounts naturally.
slots.check1: Prompts invite after first personal success only
slots.check2: Pre-writes invitation copy to remove friction
slots.check3: Unlocks team features as the growth incentive
slots.takeawayBody: Accounts with three users have half the churn rate.

slots.title: Success Milestone
slots.subtitle: Recognizing progress reinforces habit and deepens product commitment.
slots.check1: Triggers celebration at day seven usage streak
slots.check2: Shares personalized stats to boost emotional investment
slots.check3: Surveys satisfaction without disrupting the core workflow
slots.takeawayBody: Celebrated users are twice as likely to upgrade plans.

slots.title: Proactive Check
slots.subtitle: Intervening before disinterest becomes cancellation saves accounts.
slots.check1: Flags inactive accounts on day three automatically
slots.check2: Sends personal offer from customer success manager
slots.check3: Provides one-click calendar booking for human help
slots.takeawayBody: Automated outreach recovers fifteen percent of at-risk users.

slots.body: Audit your current onboarding for friction points. Build a six-step flow that guides every user to value faster.
